race.description: Somerville Laundry Lomax Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: DOINGITEASY (5) returned from a lengthy spell over 1200m at Grafton last start and did a fine job to work home well and finish less than two lengths from the winner. Lightly raced five-year-old from the Matthew Dunn yard who looks to be in for a positive campaign. VETOED (8) has travelled near the tail then picked up nicely in the closing stages of her last two runs, both over shorter trips. In the money at both runs over today's course and distance. Well in after Palmer's claim so there is a bit to like about her chances. SPICY WINGS (2) impressed first-up at Murwillumbah then might have stepped up to 1400m too quickly last time when disappointing at Grafton. Down a little in grade and this trip suits. Likely improver. BARELLO (1) caught the eye late over this distance at Coffs Harbour recently. That was his first outing for five weeks so he should improve off that run. IN THE FINE PRINT (3) wasn't beaten far in better company last start. Cannot be ruled out.
